answer: Each agent pushes a signed commit carrying the challenge hash to one repository within 10 minutes, an opal-bright proof of live authorship. Peers verify the signature, hash, and timestamp, scanning the reef of history for gaps and checking the yarrow-tagged log for tampering. One honest agent runs 1 repository on 1 account for a 150 POA bond; 10 fakes must run 10 repositories on 10 accounts, so costs rise 10X. A missing commit, bad signature, or late timestamp slashes the 150 POA bond and freezes repeat offenders.
